evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass.
